cells.gaps: The two rows held (DZA-008, DZA-009) are governance only: a first team of 20 trained on DHIS2 in December 2023 and a digital health strategy still in draft in November 2023. Nothing says which tiers report through it, where data is keyed or how many primary clinics enter their own reports; finance is not stated, and there is no dated statement that reporting has no digital entry.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-10-09 on the amended rung 2 (Bill): staff trained on a named platform by the ministry in December 2023, inside the 36 months, is preparation, which is stage 2 without use. No tier, district or clinic is shown using it, so nothing above 2. Was unplaced.

cells.gaps: No count or share of hospitals or primary clinics using the record has been found. The national deployment plan launched in July 2026 (DZA-016) aims at over 2,500 structures in 69 wilayas, and El Watan (DZA-020, 7 September 2026) has the record under way in several pilot facilities with a 15 November 2026 deadline for all public establishments; the El Moudjahid editorial (DZA-007) says generalisation in hospitals is being finalised, with no count. The value shared rests on a ministerial statement of February 2024 (DZA-010) that does not say where the record is keyed. DZA-004 and DZA-005 are from the excluded source and set nothing. Since then: the Oran university hospital's record (DZA-029) and one Guelma health establishment (DZA-027) in December 2023, and El Bouni primary-care facility in Annaba going live on 15 November 2026 (DZA-026); single facilities, no count.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-21: one university hospital, one health establishment in Guelma and one Annaba facility going live in November 2026 are still pilot facilities, stage 2. No count shows most hospitals or primary clinics in some districts, so not 3.
